messages:
emma: Heads up — main CI is red after the cmake image roll from last night. Link failures on linux targets, e.g. //server:binary. Anyone seen this yet?
ci-bot: Build #12842 failed on ubuntu-20.04 (link error). Log: `undefined reference to 'RegisterFooProcessor'` — https://ci.internal/12842/job.log
maya: I can repro locally with the new toolchain image: `bazel build //server:binary --config=linux-release`
```
maya:  ERROR: /workspace/server/BUILD:42:12: Linking of rule '//server:binary' failed (Exit 1): gcc failed: error executing command
maya: /usr/bin/ld: /workspace/_solib_k8/_U_S_C_libsomething.so: undefined reference to `RegisterFooProcessor'
maya: collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
liam: My hunch: the cmake change made transitive link deps non-propagating for some cc_* wrappers we upstreamed. The missing symbol looks like it comes from a plugin lib that used to be pulled via transitive linking.
chandler: Can someone run a quick git bisect? @liam you edited the toolchain image last week, maybe related.
liam: on it — starting bisect on CI now. Will try to narrow to a single commit and then run local builds to confirm.
maya: quick check: building with `-Wl,--start-group` around the plugin libs makes it link (temporary workaround).
liam: bisect update: narrowed to range `a1b2c3d..f4e5d6a`. Culprit looks like `f4e5d6a` which changed how `cc_library` generated linkflags for PRIVATE vs PUBLIC deps.
emma: nice find. Can we revert that change on CI to confirm?
liam: opened a revert CI run: https://ci.internal/12845 — queued
ci-bot: Build #12845 (revert) started on ubuntu-20.04
ci-bot: Build #12845 succeeded — link step passed.
chandler: OK that confirms it. Thanks @liam and @maya.
emma: Next steps: liam, please put up a small PR that keeps the improved header visibility from f4e5d6a but restores explicit link propagation for the plugin path. Maya can review the linking tweak.
liam: Will do. Drafting PR now, linking to bisect results and logs. PR: https://gh.internal/redwood/server/pull/4523 :memo:
maya: I'll review and try out the `--start-group`-free fix locally tomorrow. If it's urgent we can temporarily pin the cmake image until the PR merges.
chandler: :thumbsup: Good triage. Logging this as a quick incident and adding the revert to the rollback audit.
emma: thanks everyone — closing the loop here once PR merges and CI is stable.
